map.由数值序列求样本标准差 使用指南: Sample Standard Deviation from a Data Series User Guide
map.输入以逗号或空格分隔的一组数值，计算样本标准差 s，反映数据相对均值的平均离散程: Enter a set of values separated by commas or spaces to compute the sample standard deviation s, the average dispersion about the mean, using n−1 as the denominator for an unbiased estimate — suitable for gauging how much a set of observations fluctuates.
map.最常用的离散度指标。: The most commonly used dispersion metric.
map.与方差同量纲（原单位）。: Same dimension as the variance (in the original units).
map.由样本均值、假设均值与标准差求 t 值: t-Value from Sample Mean, Hypothesized Mean, and Standard Deviation
map.由数值序列求样本方差: Sample Variance from a Data Series
map.标准差与方差选谁？: Which Should I Use, Standard Deviation or Variance?
map.方差用于公式（如 ANOVA），标准差与数据同单位更易解释，报告用标准差。: Variance is what goes into formulas (such as ANOVA), while the standard deviation shares the data's units and is easier to interpret, so report the standard deviation.
map.样本估计用 n−1（无偏）；仅当数据为完整总体时用 n（见总体方差）。: Sample estimates use n−1 (unbiased); use n only when the data is the entire population (see population variance).
